description: On a PHYSICAL LINK BREAK REQUEST for Higher Priority traffic, new C_PDUs of at least the stated priority still start, lower ones do not; once clean the link is broken and the held C_PDU is rejected.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ at 0. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) at 2000, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED out at 52000, and the link made when that transmission ends at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400): link_state linked and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215). The peer is recorded Ed4 (B-0408) and the 16-bit family is in force. At 61000 the peer's DATA-ONLY (FSN 0) carries a PHYSICAL LINK BREAK REQUEST with reason 1, Higher Priority, and Priority 5 (octets 61 05, B-0171, B-0172, B-0311): cas.first_data stops, link_state closing (B-0244, B-0423), and from now on new C_PDUs below priority 5 do not start, those of 5 or more do (B-0252, B-0253, B-0319). At 61500 conn 1 sends two ARQ U_PDUs to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3, TTL 0: 'low' at priority 2, then 'high' at priority 7; both go down to the DTS, and dts.ttd runs to their common TTD. At 78000 'high' (10 bytes as a C_PDU) goes in a DATA-ACK (FSN 0, RX LWE 1, C-1128), 32 bytes, 2 blocks, EOT 20, then an ACK-ONLY copy (C-1154); 'low' has not started and is held. At 96000 the peer acknowledges FSN 0: dts.ack_wait stops, 'high' is confirmed; dts.ttd stays, since 'low' has the same TTD. At 97000 the link is clean, since 'low' may not start (B-0254, B-0422): link_state breaking and PHYSICAL LINK BREAK with reason 3, higher priority (B-0302, B-0423), octet 43, out at 146000; cas.break from 151550. At 161000 the peer's confirm: cas.break stops, link_state unlinked, and D_CONNECTION_TERMINATED makes the DTS reject 'low', which was never sent (C-0652, C-0866), so with nothing queued dts.ttd is cancelled. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly (25 bytes; EOT and reception window 10), C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000 ms (K-0080). The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
